column1: # What the player could work toward between runs. A goal is reached once every step it
# gives holds, and counts as many steps away as it requires and the player lacks. Steps
# are split on "; ": quest NAME, started NAME, skill SKILL LEVEL, diary AREA TIER,
# has CAPABILITY, owns ITEM IDS; "iron " before a step asks it of an ironman only.
# A goal waits while the goal before it in a chain (next) is unreached. patches and seconds
# are what it opens or saves on the run it helps most, and only rank goals. A goal is dropped once
# the player holds every step of any group in unless (groups split on " | "): what another
# goal gives that leaves this one paying nothing. A goal that opens patches names them in
# opens, and is dropped while the player's own run already reaches every one. A goal that
# shortens a walk names in opens the patches it opens instead for a player whose run reaches
# none of them, and then says opening, not payoff, and ranks with the goals that open
# patches. The payoff also needs any one group in via (groups split on " | "), each a way
# in, and the goal counts the nearest group's steps too. A negative icon is minus an
# interface sprite's id, named from SpriteID.
